authoring.draft:
const:
  output_path: ./out/copy.md
  source_path: ./notes/brief.md
nika: compiled-workflow
outputs:
  write_status: ${{ tasks.write_output.status }}
permits:
  fs:
    read:
    - ./notes/brief.md
    write:
    - ./out/copy.md
  tools:
  - nika:read
  - nika:write
tasks:
  read_source:
    invoke:
      args:
        path: ${{ const.source_path }}
      tool: nika:read
  write_output:
    after:
      read_source: success
    invoke:
      args:
        content: ${{ with.content }}
        create_dirs: true
        overwrite: true
        path: ${{ const.output_path }}
      tool: nika:write
    with:
      content: ${{ tasks.read_source.output }}
